# sparknet

> sparknet is a two-role fabric — an implemented peer node and an elected
> Master signing role — joined by one contract (`contracts/`) and one signed
> authorization implementation (`shared/`). This vault is the fabric root and
> its knowledge base.

Read `AGENTS.md` first: it is the charter (roles, layout, Memory/Plan
Protocol, boundaries). `STYLE_GUIDE.md` is how work is written. `index.md` is
the curated knowledge index; `PLAN.md` is the plan cursor.

## Contracts and shared code

- `contracts/` — the cross-role single source of truth: overlay, capabilities,
  identity, ports, guard/share/consensus/health/provenance protocols; rendered
  inventory in `contracts/manifest.json`.
- `shared/sparknet-authz.py` — the one signing/verification implementation;
  never copied.
- `contracts/README.md` — what each contract file governs.
- `contracts/deployment-runbook.md`, `contracts/spark-node-runbook.md` — how a
  real deployment is assembled and verified.

## Roles

- `peer-node/` — the implemented node: guard, anchor, dispatch bridge, agent
  ports, its own vault. Read `peer-node/AGENTS.md`.
- `master-node/` — the elected signing role, built and proven live; runs the
  peer's services by path and owns the isolated signer. Read
  `master-node/AGENTS.md`.

## Commands

- Setup: `make devtools`, `make hooks`
- Gates: `make ci` (local pre-merge gate, authoritative), `make test-all`,
  `make contract-test`, `make drift-check`, `make keys-check`,
  `make shims-check`
- Navigation: `make help`, `make layout`, `make help-role`
- Deployables: `make bundle ROLE=peer|master`, `make bundle-verify ROLE=…`
- Resource-first: `make nv-search q="…"` before building your own container
  or model; see `references/nvidia-build-catalog.md`.

## Knowledge layout

- `concepts/`, `entities/`, `skills/`, `synthesis/` — distilled pages
- `references/` — external material and provenance (`pair-architecture-review`,
  `nvidia-dsx-standard-practice`, `nvidia-build-catalog`)
- `sessions/` — per-session memory; `MEMORY.md` — standing state; `log.md` —
  append-only audit trail
- `plans/`, `_raw/`, `_archives/` — history and staging

## Boundaries

Cross-role changes are atomic (one commit, then `make contract-test`). No
secrets are tracked. Offensive security work does not belong in a default
session (see `AGENTS.md`).
